description: Sends the records waiting in this project's outbox to the signafAIde service (or the SIGNAFAIDE_URL witness) now, the same as `signafaide flush`, and saves the receipts that come back beside the records. What is sent is each record's envelope (hashes, agent and tool names, times) with the agent's signature, never inputs or outputs unless stored content was turned on in the code. Use it after signafaide_init, or when signafaide_status shows records waiting. Records also ship by themselves while the agent runs, and signafaide_verify ships them before it checks; this tool only ships. It sends only when an API key already exists, which means a person opted in with `signafaide init`, signafaide_init or SIGNAFAIDE_API_KEY. Without a key it does nothing and says so: it never creates a sandbox and never opts in. Returns how many records were shipped, how many are left in the outbox, each chain that is BLOCKED with its next step, and each error with its code (see signafaide_explain_error). Safe to repeat: a record that has shipped is not sent again.

directory.description: Path of the project to work on: the folder the MCP server was started in, or one below it. Default: that folder.

name: signafaide_flush
title: Send the waiting signafAIde records now
